catalog_metadata.title: GULA Platform Event Contract Catalog
catalog_metadata.description: Comprehensive catalog of all domain events across the GULA Platform, organized by domain.

laboratory.description: Laboratory Information Management System (LIMS) domain events covering specimen, order, result, quality, instrument, inventory, and report lifecycles. All events use the transactional outbox pattern for guaranteed delivery.

clinical.description: Core clinical domain events representing the canonical patient/order/result lifecycle. These are the shared platform events used across bounded contexts and consumed by the in-process EventBus.

identity.description: Master Patient Index (MPI) and identity resolution domain events. Handle patient identity verification, duplicate detection, matching, and claiming workflows across labs.

national.description: National Health Data System (SNDHS) domain events. Cover citizen registry, patient linking, healthcare encounters, identity resolution, family management, and consent lifecycle at the national level.

infrastructure.description: Infrastructure-level events for FHIR interoperability, HL7 messaging, terminology management, and security audit logging. These provide cross-cutting integration capabilities.
